title: AFTER HOURS projects
description: Everything listed on /after-hours and /projects. Read by src/lib/projects.js, which also checks the rules this schema can't express (category ids exist under categories[kind], slugs are unique, case study files exist).

categories.description: Category chips per kind, in display order. Items reference a category by id; label is what the page shows.

items.description: Display order on /after-hours, /projects and /portfolio is the order of this array. Every item also needs a stop under # Timeline in content/site.md.

month.description: YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for a dated piece like an op-ed.

slug.description: URL: /after-hours/project/<slug>. Changing it breaks existing links.

category.description: An id from categories[kind]. Kept in sync with the lists in projects.json for editor autocomplete; the build checks it against those lists.

start.description: Drives the ('24) year label, the 24Q4 flip clock and the (Oct - Dec) tag.

end.description: Leave out for a one-off piece. null means ongoing and shows as NOW.

blurb.description: Plain text, one or two sentences. Shown on the After Hours blurbs, /projects and the case study. A blank line (\n\n) starts a new paragraph.

caseStudy.description: Path to the case study's Markdown file, relative to content/ (convention: case-studies/<slug>.md). Rendered on /after-hours/project/<slug>. Optional for either kind: with one, the item is a blurb on /after-hours and on its kind's page (/projects or /portfolio); without one, it shows only as its stop under # Timeline in content/site.md.

images.description: The first image is the cover. Put files in public/projects/<slug>/.

links.description: External links (published piece, repo, live site), shown on the item's page.
